# cloudxino_server (Resource)

A CC2 cloud server. Created servers are billed from the team's wallet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_server" "web" {
  name        = "web-01"
  image       = "debian-13"
  size        = "s-1vcpu-1gb"
  ssh_key_ids = [cloudxino_ssh_key.laptop.id]
  tags        = ["web"]

  timeouts = {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) OS image, e.g. `debian-13` (the console's create page lists them).
- `name` (String) Hostname: letters, digits and hyphens (1-63).
- `size` (String) Plan slug, e.g. `s-1vcpu-1gb`. Changing it resizes the server in place (disks only grow).

### Optional

- `ip_type` (String) `public` (own IPv4) or `nat` (shared IP with a port range).
- `login_method` (String) `key` (SSH keys only) or `password`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root password when `login_method` is `password`: 10-128 characters with a lower case letter, an upper case letter and a digit. Kept in state.
- `project_id` (String) Left out = the team's default project.
- `region` (String) Region ID; left out = the default region.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) IDs of `cloudxino_ssh_key`s to put on the server (at creation only).
- `tags` (Set of String) Labels; Cloud Firewalls can apply by tag.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `vpc_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `disk` (Number) GB.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String)
- `memory` (Number) MB.
- `private_ip` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_server.web <server_id>
```
